output.headline: The insurer rejected your claim based on a waiting period, but your policy's waiting period has already passed.
what_happened: Suraksha Health Insurance Co. (fictional) refused to pay your hospital bill for the knee replacement surgery.
They stated that you are still in the pre-existing disease waiting period.
Additionally, some documents like investigation reports and the implant invoice are missing from the papers.
why: Your policy has a 36-month pre-existing disease waiting period, but you have already completed 40 months of continuous cover.
The insurer's reason for rejection does not match your policy rules because your waiting time is over.
Also, the insurer needs all supporting documents like investigation reports and implant invoices to process the bills.
next_steps: Ask the hospital desk to help write an appeal against the waiting period rejection.
Gather and submit the missing investigation reports and the implant invoice to the hospital desk.
Keep your policy papers and continuous cover records safe.
Check with the hospital desk before paying any money out of pocket.
output.reassurance: We are preparing a written request to the insurer to review their decision and correct this rejection.
